title: Motion Machine sound recipe (SPEC §9): one cue as data
description: A cue written as layers, rendered by runtime/kit/synth.js `layers`. A tone layer is sine partials with a linear attack and an exponential decay set by its T60 (the time to fall 60 dB); partial n decays in t60 x ratio^-slope (0.75 unless the layer says), never faster than 28 ms. A noise layer is seeded white noise through one biquad. A pass layer is a whoosh (one level curve in dB rising into an apex, bands that move with it) and a gated layer a pulse train whose period shrinks and which ends open. Any layer may carry an envelope in dB (replacing attack and t60), a gate, a tremolo, a drive, a sweep and a chain of filters; a tone may name a table of modes and beat as a doublet. `from` is the emphasis rank a layer joins at (subtle 0, normal 1, strong 2 unless `emphasis` says otherwise); `offsetS` starts it later in the cue. For a noise layer `filter.f` is the filter's centre and `glideTo` sweeps it. `durationS` is the cue's length: the time by which every layer has ended (offsetS + attackS + t60, or offsetS + lengthS), at most 4.5 s. The cue's family follows from it (familyOf in synth.js): input up to 0.06 s, surface up to 0.3 s, outcome up to 0.65 s, longer a swell. `variants` are named edits of the base (the default version), `knobs` the params a beat may set.

name.description: the cue's name: the folder patterns/sound/<name>/ it lives in and the `cue` a beat names

meaning.description: the visible event the cue marks, in words

masterGain.description: a linear gain on the whole cue, set by measuring so its loudest 100 ms lands on the matched level (-30 LUFS) rendered as written; 1 by default

vary.description: a cue that sounds many times (an input cue) varies a little each time, pitch and force together (one seeded draw for both); an outcome cue leaves it out and is identical every time

pitch.description: the largest shift of every frequency, as a fraction (0.02 is 2 %)

force.description: the largest change of the cue's level, as a fraction

emphasis.description: the rank of each arrangement; a layer plays when the rank of the beat's emphasis is at least its `from`

variant.description: the name of the version the base layers are (the default of the `variant` knob)

variants.description: named versions of the cue, each an edit of the base: a new durationS, masterGain or finish, and a partial layer by layer index (a layer whose peak is 0 does not play, so a version can switch one on)

key.description: the pitch class the layers marked `keyed` are written in; the `key` knob moves them from it

knobs.description: the params this cue adds to gain, seed and emphasis: variant (which version), step (semitones up, for a ladder of repeats), key (the pitch class), durS (aim the cue at a length, runtime/kit/aim.js)

finish.description: what the whole cue goes through before its gain and room: a high-pass, a peaking dip, soft saturation that keeps the peak, a gate (the hard end of a click)

highpassHz.description: a second-order high-pass, fourth-order above 800 Hz

room.description: the shared room: a short seeded stereo convolution. `send` is dB under the dry cue; the shape (predelay, size, lowpass) is the same for every cue of a palette, which is what makes them one place

gate.description: from `atS` the level drops by `dropDb` over `releaseS`; 90 dB or more is a hard end

releaseS.description: the ramp of the drop, 0.004 by default

db.description: the level against the air, dB

glideOct.description: sub: octaves it sinks after the apex

open.description: hiss: octaves its low-pass opens with the motion

pow.description: hiss: its level curve is the pass's level to this power

f.description: tone: the fundamental in Hz; pass: the centre of its air at the apex (420 Hz by default); gated: the pitch of a tone source

glideTo.description: tone: the fundamental it glides to; noise: the filter centre it sweeps to; null for no glide

glideS.description: how long the glide takes, from the start of the layer (an exponential sweep)

attackS.description: linear rise to the peak; 0.001 to 0.003 for a struck sound, longer for a swell

t60.description: seconds for the layer to fall 60 dB after its peak

peak.description: the layer's linear level before the cue's gain; 1 by default; 0 switches a layer off (a variant can switch it on)

partials.description: tone: [ratio to the fundamental, level in dB] pairs, the fundamental included; [[1, 0]] by default

from.description: the emphasis rank the layer joins at: 0 always, 1 from normal up (an ornament that subtle drops), 2 only at strong (the layer strong adds)

offsetS.description: when the layer starts, from the start of the cue

lengthS.description: pass and gated: how long the layer lasts

envelope.description: [[tS, dB], ...] breakpoints, straight in dB between them, silent outside; replaces attackS and t60 on a tone or noise layer and multiplies a pass or gated one; end it at -60 dB or lower

drive.description: soft saturation: tanh with gain 1 + 2 x drive on the oscillator or the filtered noise, level kept

sweep.description: [[tS, hz], ...]: the filter centre of a noise or gated layer, or the fundamental of a tone, moving exponentially between points

chain.description: filters run over the layer after its envelope, each repeated `stages` times

modes.description: tone: the partials of a table of modes (runtime/kit/modes.js), unless `partials` is given

slope.description: tone: a partial decays in t60 x ratio^-slope; 0.75 by default

beatHz.description: tone: every partial is a doublet beating at about this rate, each its own seeded share of it

keyed.description: tone: the `key` knob moves this layer from the recipe's key

periodS.description: gated: [start, end] period of the pulses; the train is laid out from the end so the last pulse is open

depth.description: gated: how far the gate closes between pulses

openS.description: gated: the gate opens over the last stretch of the layer

rampS.description: gated: the edge of a pulse

riseDb.description: gated: the level rises by this many dB over the layer

periodCurve.description: gated: the period shrinks along u^periodCurve

apexAt.description: pass: where the loudest moment sits, as a share of the length (0.5 to 0.7 for a whoosh that reads as a pass)

riseK.description: pass: below 1 the level accelerates into the apex

fallK.description: pass: above 1 the level holds, then drops

upOct.description: pass: octaves the air sits under its centre at the start

downOct.description: pass: octaves it sinks to by the end

track.description: pass: the motion is the level to this power

lpRatio.description: pass: a low-pass at this multiple of the air centre

doppler.description: pass: semitones the bands glide, high before the apex and low after

low.description: pass: a band of brown noise under the air

sub.description: pass: a soft-saturated sine that sinks after the apex

hiss.description: pass: high-passed noise whose top opens with the motion
